# Asset licences

Generated by `tools/make_licenses.py` from `assets/manifest.json`; the licence text of every piece was read at its source (see `license_evidence`).

* Icons: Lucide (ISC), `assets/svg/LICENSE-lucide.txt`. Hand-drawn doodles are generated by `sketch.py` (this project).
* Fonts: SIL Open Font License 1.1, one `OFL-*.txt` per family in `fonts/`.
* Audio: below. CC0 needs no credit; CC-BY must be credited (the editor writes `<video>.credits.txt` on export).
